newsitem.title: USA: July best month this year for futures funds.
newsitem.headline: July best month this year for futures funds.

text.p: July was the best month this year for returns for managed futures and currency funds monitored by consultants TASS Management Ltd.
For July the top fund in the managed futures and currency category was Dunn Capital Financial's TOPS program, which saw a return of 33.40 pct, according to TASS Management Ltd.
The second best fund was Liquinvest Ltd's 2000 program, with a 24.28 pct return.
Fund performance overall was buoyed by rallies in currency markets, European stock markets, and U.S. fixed income markets, according to TASS Management.
Many of the top managers saw good returns from being long the U.S. dollar and British pound.
Long positions in European stocks and U.S. and Australian fixed income markets were also winning strategies, as was shorting gold, TASS Management said.
"Overall it was an excellent month for futures and currency funds," TASS Management chief executive Nicola Meaden said.
Continuing a long time trend, traders using strategies based on "technical analysis" of markets dominated the top ten rankings in July.

"Technical analysis" uses past market price, volume and open interest data to estimate future trends, and compares with "fundamental analysis" involving the study of economic indicators, or earnings valuations, or supply and demand data.
The TASS Management monthly report monitors the performance of 70 futures and currency managers, each with a minimum of $45 million under management.
TASS Management Ltd is a London-based research company which monitors about 1,600 alternative investment managers globally.
The "alternative investment" universe includes hedge funds, CTAs, managed currency managers, emerging market funds and funds of funds.
